intro.title: FUNDA — Expandable FAQ Accordion
intro.body: In this lesson you will build an Expandable FAQ Accordion — a set of question/answer panels where clicking a question expands it with a smooth animation while collapsing any other open panel (exclusive open mode) or allowing multiple open panels (multi-open mode). You will architect it as a parent AccordionComponent that uses @ContentChildren to discover its AccordionItemComponent children projected via ng-content, coordinate their open/close state from the parent, and apply Angular Animations for smooth height transitions.
intro.usecase: Accordions, tab groups, steppers, and disclosure panels share the same architectural pattern: a parent component that orchestrates the state of multiple projected child components — the pattern inside Angular Material's MatExpansionPanel and MatStepper.
